title: neilsonnn/image-blaster
claim: neilsonnn/image-blaster — An image-to-world skillset for Claude.
why_good: A few hundred lines of orchestration drew 4.7k stars — the vote is for the destination, not the code: image-to-usable-3D is wanted badly enough that people star a glue script for it. Worth noting commits stopped in mid-May, so the pull is on the outcome, not this implementation.
value: The buyer is anyone paying a 3D artist for blockout work: indie game studios, arch-viz and previz shops, AR and product teams. The business is the unglamorous middle — retopology, scale and pivot correction, UVs, engine-ready export — sold per asset or per seat, because raw generative meshes are not shippable and cleanup is where the hours go.
risk: Thin orchestration over two paid APIs, and both World Labs and FAL have every reason to ship the finished pipeline themselves. Output quality is still short of production-usable, so any business rests on cleanup tooling maturing faster than the generators absorb it — and this repo has been idle since May.
does: A Claude skill pack that walks a single image through World Labs and FAL to a meshed 3D environment with sound effects, in a few minutes.
edge: A few hundred lines of orchestration drew 4.7k stars — the vote is for the destination, not the code: image-to-usable-3D is wanted badly enough that people star a glue script for it. Worth noting commits stopped in mid-May, so the pull is on the outcome, not this implementation.
why_use: Gets you from a reference image to a rough 3D environment fast enough to be worth trying before modelling anything.
hook: Transform a single image into a fully meshed 3D environment in seconds with IMAGE-BLASTER.

zh.claim: 将单张图像在几秒钟内转化为完整的网格3D环境，使用IMAGE-BLASTER。
zh.hook: 将单张图像在几秒钟内转化为完整的网格3D环境，使用IMAGE-BLASTER。
zh.does: 一套 Claude 技能包，把一张图片依次送过 World Labs 和 FAL，几分钟内产出带音效的、已经布好网格的 3D 场景。
zh.edge: 几百行胶水代码换来 4.7k star——大家投的是这个结果，而不是这段代码：从图片到可用 3D 的需求强到让人愿意给一段脚本点星。要注意提交在 5 月中就停了，所以拉力在目标上，不在这个实现上。
zh.why_use: 从一张参考图到粗模场景足够快，快到值得在正式建模前先试一遍。
zh.value: 买家是现在花钱请 3D 美术做白模的人：独立游戏团队、建筑可视化和前期分镜工作室、AR 与产品团队。生意在不体面的中间环节——重拓扑、尺度与轴心修正、UV、引擎可用的导出——按资产或按坐席收费，因为生成出来的原始网格没法直接上线，工时都耗在收拾上。
zh.risk: 本质是两个付费 API 之上的薄胶水层，而 World Labs 和 FAL 都有充足理由自己把整条流水线做完。输出质量距离可交付仍有差距，所以这门生意取决于收尾工具的成熟速度能不能快过生成方的吞并——而这个仓库自 5 月起就没动了。
zh.why_good: 几百行胶水代码换来 4.7k star——大家投的是这个结果，而不是这段代码：从图片到可用 3D 的需求强到让人愿意给一段脚本点星。要注意提交在 5 月中就停了，所以拉力在目标上，不在这个实现上。

pick_reason: The project offers a unique product that leverages AI to create 3D models from images, addressing a clear market need in the consumer AI space.
